title: Figure 1: Frequency of Sightings by Year for Object, Unit, and All Sightings (1947–1952)
description: Three concentric pie charts break down UFO sightings by year from 1947 to 1952, with each wedge labeled by year, count and percentage (e.g., 1952 object sightings "1501 = 68.3%"). Callouts identify the rings as "Object sightings 2199 = 100%", "All sightings 3201 = 100%" and "Unit sightings 2554 = 100%". Caption reads "FIGURE 1 FREQUENCY OF SIGHTINGS BY YEAR FOR OBJECT, UNIT, AND ALL SIGHTINGS"; drawing number A-7479, page 17.
